summary: Registrant Virginia National Bankshares Corporation filed an 8-K reporting Q1 FY2026 earnings (net income $5.3M, $0.97/diluted share vs $4.5M, $0.83/share prior year) and a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.36/share declared by the Board, payable May 29, 2026. This is a standard earnings and dividend announcement with no merger, acquisition, dissolution, or other special situation. No deal terms, strategic review, activist involvement, or capital restructuring is present. The filing is purely operational and financial in nature.
